Margarita.description: Classic tequila and triple sec combination, mixed with lime juice. Garnish the rim of the glass with salt for that extra punch
Margarita.method:
Step 1: Sprinkle a few teaspoons of salt over the surface of a small plate or saucer. Rub one wedge of lime along the rim of a tumbler and then dip it into the salt so that the entire rim is covered.

Step 2: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice, then add the Tequila, lime juice and triple sec. Shake until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 3: Strain the mix into the prepared glass over fresh ice. Serve with a wedge of lime.

Woo Woo.description: Mix of vodka, peach schnapps, cranberry juice and fresh lime - making a perfect party cocktail
Woo Woo.method:
Step 1: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice then add the vodka, peach schnapps, cranberry juice and a dash of lime juice.

Step 2: Shake really well then strain into a tumbler with extra ice.

Step 3: Garnish with a wedge of lime.

Mojito.description: Classic cocktail mix using fresh mint, white rum, sugar, zesty lime and cooling sparkling water
Mojito.method:
Step 1: Muddle the lime wedges with the sugar syrup in a glass.

Step 2: Add the mint leaves and gently bruise them.

Step 3: Fill the glass with ice, pour over the white rum and top up with sparkling water. Stir well.

Cosmopolitan.description: Lipsmackingly sweet and sour cocktail of vodka, cranberry, triple sec and citrus - this is just is a good-time in a glass
Cosmopolitan.method:
Step 1: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice, then add the vodka, triple sec, cranberry juice and lime juice.

Step 2: Shake well until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 3: Strain into a martini glass and garnish with a twist of orange peel.

Whiskey Sour.description: Classic cocktail combination of bourbon, lemon juice, sugar syrup, bitters and egg white for a smooth, frothy drink
Whiskey Sour.method:
Step 1: Add the whisky, lemon juice, sugar syrup, bitters and egg white to a cocktail shaker.

Step 2: Shake vigorously without ice to emulsify the egg white.

Step 3: Add ice and shake again until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 4: Strain into a glass filled with ice and garnish with lemon zest, a slice of orange and a cherry.

Piña Colada.description: Tropical blend of rich coconut cream, white rum and tangy pineapple – serve with an umbrella for kitsch appeal
Piña Colada.method:
Step 1: Put the white rum, pineapple juice and coconut cream into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice.

Step 2: Shake until as smooth as possible.

Step 3: Pour into a chilled glass and garnish with a slice of pineapple and a cherry.

Mai Tai.description: Classic tiki cocktail combining dark and light rum, orange curaçao, lime juice, and sugar syrup
Mai Tai.method:
Step 1: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then add the golden rum, orange curaçao, orgeat syrup, lime juice and sugar syrup.

Step 2: Shake well until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 3: Fill a glass with crushed ice and strain the cocktail into the glass.

Step 4: Float the dark rum on top by pouring it over the back of a spoon.

Step 5: Garnish with a wedge of pineapple, a lime wheel and a cocktail cherry.

Blue Lagoon.description: Vibrant blue cocktail combining vodka, blue curaçao, lemon juice and sparkling water - garnish with maraschino cherries if you're feeling fancy
Blue Lagoon.method:
Step 1: Put the ice cubes in a cocktail shaker. Pour over the blue curaçao, vodka and lemon juice. Stir until the outside of the cocktail shaker feels cold.

Step 2: Half-fill a tall cocktail glass with crushed ice, then strain in the cocktail.

Step 3: Top up the cocktail glass with sparkling water and gently stir, then garnish with the maraschino cherries.

Strawberry Daiquiri.description: Fruity twist on the classic daiquiri, blending white rum, lime juice, sugar syrup and fresh strawberries
Strawberry Daiquiri.method:
Step 1: Muddle the strawberries in a cocktail shaker.

Step 2: Add the white rum, lime juice, sugar syrup and ice.

Step 3: Shake well until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 4: Strain into a chilled glass and garnish with a strawberry.

Espresso Martini.description: Classy, sophisticated cocktail combining vodka, coffee liqueur and freshly brewed espresso - a coffee lovers favourite
Espresso Martini.method:
Step 1: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice, then add the vodka, coffee liqueur and freshly brewed espresso.

Step 2: Shake well until the outside of the shaker feels cold.

Step 3: Strain into a martini glass and garnish with coffee beans.

Caipirinha.description: South american favoiurite - this brazilian cocktail is made with white rum, lime and sugar, served over crushed ice
Caipirinha.method:
Step 1: Muddle the lime wedges with the sugar syrup in a glass.

Step 2: Fill the glass with crushed ice and pour over the white rum.

Step 3: Stir well and serve.

Long Island Iced Tea.description: potent mix of vodka, tequila, white rum, gin, triple sec, lemon juice and cola. Fortune favours the bold
Long Island Iced Tea.method:
Step 1: Fill a glass with ice and add the vodka, tequila, white rum, gin, triple sec and lemon juice.

Step 2: Top up with cola to your liking and stir gently.

Step 3: Garnish with a lemon wedge.

Tom Collins.description: Refreshing gin-based cocktail with lemon juice, sugar syrup and sparkling water
Tom Collins.method:
Step 1: Fill a glass with ice and add the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup.

Step 2: Top up with sparkling water and stir gently.

Step 3: Garnish with a lemon slice and a cherry.

Rum Punch.description: Fruity and boozy punch combining dark and white rum with tropical juices and a dash of grenadine
Rum Punch.method:
Step 1: Fill a shaker with ice and pour in both rums, orange juice, pineapple juice, and grenadine.

Step 2: Shake well until chilled.

Step 3: Strain into a tall glass filled with ice and garnish with an orange slice and cherry.

Aperol Spritz.description: Stone cold classic - this light and refreshing Italian aperitif made with Aperol, prosecco, and a splash of sparkling water
Aperol Spritz.method:
Step 1: Fill a large wine glass with ice.

Step 2: Pour over the Aperol, followed by the prosecco, then top with sparkling water.

Step 3: Stir gently and garnish with an orange slice.

Tequila Sunrise.description: Visually striking cocktail made with tequila, orange juice, and grenadine - a match made in heaven
Tequila Sunrise.method:
Step 1: Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the tequila and orange juice.

Step 2: Slowly pour the grenadine down the side of the glass to create a sunrise effect.

Step 3: Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry.

Sex on the Beach.description: Crowd favourite - a fruity mix of vodka, peach schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice
Sex on the Beach.method:
Step 1: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add all the ingredients.

Step 2: Shake well and strain into a highball glass filled with ice.

Step 3: Garnish with an orange slice.

Amaretto Sour.description: Sweet and tangy cocktail made with amaretto liqueur, lemon juice, and a touch of egg white for a velvety texture
Amaretto Sour.method:
Step 1: Add the amaretto, lemon juice, sugar syrup, and egg white (if using) to a cocktail shaker without ice and gently shake to emulsify.

Step 2: Add ice and shake again until well chilled.

Step 3: Strain into a shallow glass filled with ice and garnish with a lemon slice and cherry.

Hurricane.description: Cocktail with a statement - this bold number is made with dark and white rum, passion fruit juice, and citrus
Hurricane.method:
Step 1: Fill a shaker with ice and add all the ingredients.

Step 2: Shake well and strain into a hurricane glass filled with ice.

Step 3: Garnish with an orange slice and cherry.

Pink Lady.description: Classic, elegant pink cocktail combining gin, grenadine, and egg white
Pink Lady.method:
Step 1: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker without ice and shake gently to emulsify the egg white.

Step 2: Add ice and shake again until chilled.

Step 3: Strain into a chilled cocktail glass and garnish with a cherry.

Strawberry Mojito.description: Fruity twist on the classic mojito with fresh strawberries, lime, mint, rum and sparkling water
Strawberry Mojito.method:
Step 1: Muddle the strawberries, lime and sugar syrup in a glass.

Step 2: Add the mint leaves and gently bruise.

Step 3: Fill the glass with ice, pour over the rum and top with sparkling water. Stir well.

Mint Julep.description: Refreshing whisky-based cocktail served with crushed ice and fresh mint
Mint Julep.method:
Step 1: Muddle the mint leaves, sugar syrup and water in a julep cup or glass.

Step 2: Fill the glass with crushed ice and add the bourbon.

Step 3: Stir until the outside of the glass is frosty and garnish with a mint sprig.

Hugo Spritz.description: Favourite of Lauren's - refreshing, floral, and herbal, the Hugo cocktail is a delightful choice for a delightful bride-to-be
Hugo Spritz.method:
Step 1: Gently scrunch the mint in your hands to lightly bruise it, then put in the bottom of a large wine glass. Pour over the elderflower cordial and gin and leave to infuse for 1-2 mins..

Step 2: Fill the glass with ice, then pour over the soda water and prosecco. Stir gently to combine. Garnish with the lime wedge and mint sprig before serving.

Purple Rain.description: Throwback! Mix up a batch of purple rain cocktail for a fun, retro and creative serve
Purple Rain.method:
Step 1: Half fill a cocktail shaker with ice, then pour in the vodka, gin, blue curaçao, lime juice and lemon juice and stir well.

Step 2: Top up with the sparkling water, grenadine and more ice, then stir again.

Step 3: Half-fill a tall cocktail glass with ice and pour over the cocktail (optionally garnish with the slices of lime).

Passion Fruit Martini.description: Easy passion fruit cocktail that's bursting with zingy flavours - perfect for celebrating with friends
Passion Fruit Martini.method:
Step 1: Scoop the seeds from one of the passion fruits into the glass of a cocktail shaker, add the vodka, passion fruit liqueur, lime juice and sugar syrup.

Step 2: Add a handful of ice and shake well, strain into a martini glass, then add half a passion fruit for garnish. Be sure to fill a shot glass with Prosecco.

Step 3: Serve! (You can decide whether to shot or dunk the proescco!)

Virgin Mojito.description: Refreshing, non-alcoholic mojito cocktail recipe that skips the usual rum to create a tasty booze-free blend
Virgin Mojito.method:
Step 1: Muddle the sugar with leaves from the mint using a pestle and mortar (or use a small bowl and the end of a rolling pin).

Step 2: Put a handful of crushed ice into a tall glasses. Pour the lime juice into the glass with the mint mix. Add a straw and top up with sparkling water.

Apple, Elderflower & Mint Sparkle.description: Fruity and creative non-alcoholic punch perfect for the anybody who wants to leave the alcohol aside
ingredients: Small Handful of Mint Leaves, roughly chopped
Apple, Elderflower & Mint Sparkle.method:
Step 1: Mix the elderflower cordial with the cloudy apple juice. Add a small handful of mint leaves, stir well.

Step 2: Pour juice into a glass and top up with sparkling water.

Non-Alcoholic Sangria.description: Twist on the european classic. This gives fun and fruitiness of a summery sangria with none of the alcohol! Suitable for a large pitcher, but can be easily altered to be a single person drink!
Non-Alcoholic Sangria.method:
Step 1: Pour the lemonade, cranberry juice and orange juice into a large pitcher and stir well.

Step 2: Add ice and the chopped fruit and mint in layers. Stir to combine.

Step 3: Serve in goblet glasses or a large wine glass.

Watermelon Cooler.description: Simple serve! No fancy equipment is needed to make this tasty watermelon drink! Best served chilled
Watermelon Cooler.method:
Step 1: Muddle the watermelon in the bottom of a glass, then stir in the lemon juice.

Step 2: Sieve the watermelon if needed, pressing down gently on the pulp to extract all the juice.

Step 3: Pour the juice into glasses filled with ice and garnish with the mint.

Mint Lemonade.description: Homemade lemonade recipe which makes for a refreshing addition to any party
Mint Lemonade.method:
Step 1: Add the lemon juice to a glass with the lime juice and sugar. Stir well until the sugar is dissolved.

Step 2: Top up with plenty of ice and sparkling water. Mix well and add more sugar, to taste.

Step 3: Add the mint sprigs, if using, and stir well.

Fruit Punch Mocktail.description: Fruit-flavoured mocktail with grenadine and orange juice. It's more fun with strawberry stirrers that double as a snack
Fruit Punch Mocktail.method:
Step 1: Pour the grenadine into four glasses. Gently tip the glasses and pour the orange juice down the inside of the glasses so it sits on top of the grenadine.

Step 2: Top up with sparkling water, and add the strawberries (on skewers, if you have them!) to serve.

Passion Fruit & Elderflower Spritz.description: Stylish passion fruit and elderflower number - your new go-to alcohol-free drink. It's fruity, fizzy and fabulous
Passion Fruit & Elderflower Spritz.method:
Step 1: Make sure all the ingredients are well chilled before you start. Ideally chill a flute glass too.

Step 2: Pour all of the ingredients into your glass, taking your time when you add the sparkling water so it doesn't overflow, then stir gently.
